# Price the vent, the gas upsize, and the attic — not a flat $1,200 swap.

> Price a residential water heater replacement from the tank or tankless type, the location, the vent, and the gas or electrical path — plus walk-away price, dollars per gallon, and how many times a typical 50-gallon electric garage swap this house really is.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
